setup: Custom VPC `vpc-c` with two iptables VPC NAT gateways (macvlan WAN legs on `egress0`): `gw-out` (lanIp 10.30.0.254, on `ovn-topo-agent1`) takes the VPC's `0.0.0.0/0` route and SNATs `vpc-c-net`; `gw-in` (lanIp 10.30.0.253, on `ovn-topo-agent2`) DNATs 8080 to pod `web` (10.30.0.10). No `src-ip` route or reroute leads to `gw-in`.
